thesis_liability.instructions: Use only actual company disclosures in the supplied filing passages, never outside knowledge or hypothetical risk factors. Dates are relative to the AS OF date in the state. A risk that might happen is not an event that has happened. Does the company disclose a quantified company-specific provision, redress/remediation programme, fine, or litigation/regulatory claim? Count management provisions or best estimates; for an asserted third-party claim count the claimed amount even if disputed or no provision is booked, but do not treat it as an established loss. EXCLUDE routine banking commitments (letters of credit, guarantees, loan commitments, derivatives notionals), uncertain tax positions and tax audits, ordinary-course legal matters without a quantified exposure, and insurance reserves. Also exclude ordinary operating provisions such as pensions, warranties, restructuring and credit losses. Answer whether a qualifying exposure exists; materiality is calculated separately in code as exposure >10% of MARKET VALUE, never book equity. Owner earnings is an additional comparison, not a veto threshold.

criteria.no: No quantified in-scope exposure; includes routine commitments, tax and insurance reserves

thesis_guidance.instructions: Use only actual company disclosures in the supplied filing passages, never outside knowledge or hypothetical risk factors. Has management guided to a fall in revenue or operating profit of MORE THAN 20% for the current full financial year? Require forward guidance, not a completed-year result, quarterly guidance, EPS guidance or a hypothetical scenario. Exactly 20% does not qualify.

criteria.yes: Current full-year revenue or operating-profit guidance implies a fall greater than 20%

thesis_distress.instructions: Use only actual company disclosures in the supplied filing passages, never outside knowledge or hypothetical risk factors. Require an actual covenant breach or a suspended/cancelled ordinary dividend, not a general risk of breach or a routine statement that dividends are discretionary. An ongoing suspension qualifies; a explicitly resolved historical event does not.

criteria.yes: Actual going-concern doubt, covenant breach or ongoing dividend suspension disclosed
